purpose: Final high-value Slayer edge routes from PvME that were still missing after the core and collection supplements.

slayer_methods.location: Guthixian automaton caves reached from the Guthix shrine / Guthixian High Druid
slayer_methods.planner_value: The three glove drops feed the enchantments of metaphysics, shadows and heroism in addition to the Slayer log.
slayer_methods.warning: PvME's site-wide Combat Modernisation notice says most older combat content is outdated, and this page also warns its AFK Necromancy prayer sustain changed after the April 2026 Aura overhaul. Keep access/drop facts; treat KPH as guide context until rebenchmarked.

slayer_methods.monster: Greater demon berserkers and ash lords
slayer_methods.location: Wilderness southwest of the Dragonkin Laboratory
slayer_methods.planner_value: PvME describes the Wilderness variants as ideal for Slayer and among the best AFK Slayer XP because they have no unique-drop opportunity cost; a sacrifice scrimshaw can therefore convert drops into extra Slayer XP.
slayer_methods.notes: Zamorakian Undercity variants exist but are not required for the planner route because the weaker poisonable Wilderness population is the recommended Slayer-training target.

locations: Monastery of Ascension in Feldip Hills
Sunken Pyramid after capturing Capsarius souls
drop_notes: Ascension grips require being on task
Ascension shards can be converted into Silent components
slayer_methods.planner_value: Kandarin supplies the natural Feldip Hills monastery route; once a soul is captured, Desert can supply the higher-KPH Sunken Pyramid farm.
slayer_methods.warning: The listed PvME setup uses Legacy Ranged and sits under the site-wide 2026 combat-outdated warning. Preserve access/drop facts and rebenchmark throughput before optimizer ranking.

requirements: The Light Within for Tarddiad access
slayer_methods.planner_value: Tarddiad is a separate plane with no published Equilibrium region mapping, while Sunken Pyramid gives a later Desert farming route once the soul is captured.
slayer_methods.warning: PvME's site-wide 2026 notice applies; do not rank the listed KPH as post-modernisation truth until rebenchmarked.

slayer_methods.planner_value: A direct Forinthry collection-log route; revenant drop enhancers improve the revenant drop table by 10% except Revenant spirit, while Elite Wilderness achievements add another 5% chance for Ancient Warriors' equipment.
slayer_methods.warning: Keep PvME KPH as guide context until it is explicitly rebenchmarked for 2026 combat tuning.
